stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Without bright screens, they had paid more attention.”?
options: Sometimes losing one small comfort helps people find other ways to use time.

The broken lights were fixed before lunch, but the teacher decided to use less screen time in future classes.
Their teacher said it was a simple lesson: when things look the same on the outside, names can save lunch.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Without bright screens, they had paid more attention. The broken lights were fixed before lunch, but the teacher decided to use less screen time…」，答案為「The broken lights were fixed before lunch, but the teacher decided to use less screen time in future…」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The broken lights were fixed before lunch, but the teacher decided to use less screen time in future…」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
